تستفتون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْتُونَ (tastaftūna) /tas.taf.tuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
# تُسْتَفْتَوْنَ (tustaftawna) /tus.taf.taw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْتَى (istaftā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
